comparison.objective: Clip a spring-hinged pulse oximeter onto a finger without dragging the hand.
comparison.physical_skill: Steadying a patient hand while opening, aligning, and releasing a spring clip.
comparison.success_condition: Oximeter is correctly seated, display-up, released, and still without excessive hand displacement.
comparison.reason: A local spring-clip placement does not test handed long-member support, paired rack-hole registration, rear extension, or load-bearing screw fastening.
